purpose: Preserve the verified evolution of continuity claim-state enforcement without implying that unresolved historical identifiers were located.

memory.statement: Continuity enforcement evolved from a descriptive transition protocol, to executable transition validation, to an atomic append-only transition journal. This lineage strengthens future provenance preservation but does not resolve the origin or location of M-004, M-005, or M-006.

stages.name: claim_state_transition_protocol
stages.role: Defined required prior state, next state, evidence, reason, privacy class, falsification route, timestamp, and actor semantics.

stages.name: claim_state_transition_validator
stages.role: Converted transition semantics into executable fail-closed validation.

stages.name: atomic_claim_transition_journal
stages.role: Added compare-and-set append semantics, idempotency, stale-head rejection, conflict detection, and bounded contention failure.

observed: The three-stage enforcement lineage exists in immutable repository commits.
The atomic journal validates a transition before compare-and-set append.
The canonical queue still lists M-004, M-005, and M-006 provenance as unresolved.
inferred: Future knowledge-graph updates can preserve contradiction and prior-state history more reliably when routed through the journal.
proposed: Bind M-RECONCILE-002 claim-state changes to the atomic transition journal once a durable backend is selected.
superseded: Treating descriptive transition prose alone as sufficient enforcement.
unresolved: Originating immutable sources for M-004, M-005, and M-006.
Production durable backend for the transition journal.

contradiction_resolution.incorrect_collapse: new enforcement capability means historical provenance is resolved
contradiction_resolution.resolution: Capability lineage and artifact provenance are separate claims; the former is observed, the latter remains unresolved.

contradiction_resolution.incorrect_collapse: latest active state replaces prior states
contradiction_resolution.resolution: The journal retains an append-only transition sequence and a current head; superseded states remain part of history.

falsification_route: Fetch each listed commit and verify that its patch implements the stated stage; reject this lineage if commit identity, ordering, or role does not match.
queue_effect: Adds a completed continuity slice only; does not close any M-RECONCILE-002 acceptance criterion.
